g.text: contact_account_id : uuid (who asked; empty if CSR-initiated)
change_status : text (AwaitingConfirmation | AwaitingApproval | Applied | Canceled | Refused | Expired)
created_grant_id : uuid (the grant this change created)
approval_status : text (Pending | Approved | Denied | Expired | Canceled)
decision_reason : text (InsufficientJustification | ExceedsCustomerAgreement | RiskConcern | DuplicateRequest | Other)
One subject account per case: the customer
account it is about. The contact is the person
account); they may be the same account.
Closing a case cancels change requests awaiting
confirmation and Pending approvals; case actions
The target is the case's subject (composite key).
Confirming applies exactly what was shown: the
subject_account_version must match and the patch's test
operations must hold; then re-authorize and apply
Constrained to one per change request (CM-6).
decision_reason is required when Denied; Other
requires a comment. Expired by the process
unique index — s: single column · c: composite
solid line: within the subsystem · dashed: another subsystem
